rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. The child reuses its two-stage operative structure: first calling on the nation to observe the same designated week and cooperate with the President's Committee, then urging nearly the same catalog of public officials and organizational leaders to participate actively. The child also echoes C05's equal-employment premise. C17 and C23 contain nearly identical operative machinery and are strong alternatives, but C05 is closest in the combination of language, sequence, and detailed participant list.

shared_material.child_excerpt: equal opportunity for employment is basic to our belief in human dignity and should never be denied to any person because of physical impairment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: opportunity for employment should not be denied any qualified person merely because of a physical handicap
shared_material.explanation: The child closely restates the same substantive premise using parallel denial-of-employment language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 2, 1960, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week, and to cooperate with the President's Committee on Employment of the Physically Handicapped
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 2, 1955, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week, and to cooperate with the President's Committee on Employment of the Physically Handicapped
shared_material.explanation: This is a near-verbatim operative provision with only the year and the concluding description of the committee's task changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I also urge the Governors of States, mayors of cities, and other public officials, as well as leaders of industry, educational and religious groups, labor, civic, veterans', agricultural, women's, scientific, professional, and fraternal organizations ... to participate actively in this observance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also urge the governors of States, mayors of municipalities, other public officials, leaders of industry and labor, and members of religious, civic, veterans', agricultural, women's, handicapped persons', and fraternal organizations to participate actively in this observance.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the parent provision's sequence, function, closing phrase, and distinctive enumeration while expanding and modestly reorganizing the listed groups.
